description: This file contains the implementation of the Store controller class in the OpenCart admin module, specifically managing store settings including listing, editing, and saving store configurations. It includes methods for displaying store lists, handling store form submissions, and loading various setting components.

classes.name: Store
classes.description: Controller class for managing store settings in the OpenCart admin interface, providing functionalities for listing stores, editing store details, and saving configurations.

classes.name: Store
classes.description: Controller class for managing store settings in the OpenCart admin interface. It includes methods for displaying, editing, and saving store configurations, handling store options, images, location data, and generating the store settings page.

classes.name: Store
classes.description: Controller class for managing store settings in the OpenCart admin interface. It includes methods for displaying, editing, saving, and deleting store configurations, handling store options, images, location data, and generating the store settings page.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the main store settings page, including a list of stores, breadcrumbs, and links for editing or adding stores.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles the request to display the list of stores, including pagination and data loading.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML view with the list of stores, handling pagination, store data retrieval, and setting up action URLs.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form to add or edit a store's details, pre-filling data if editing, and handling form submission data.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes the submission of store data, saving updated or new store configurations.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the main store settings page, initializes data, loads necessary models and layouts, and handles form presentations.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles requests to display the list of stores with pagination, calling getList to generate the HTML view.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Builds and returns the HTML table listing all stores, manages pagination and actions.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the add/edit form for store configurations, loads current store data, options, images, and layout components, and prepares the form for user interaction.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes submitted store configuration data and saves it through model calls.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected store entries, with permission checks and cleanup of related settings.
